subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` and the `parentPeer` addition to `openclaw/plugin-sdk/inbound-envelope` as the public config/SDK shape for Google Chat DM thread sessions?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but config and Plugin SDK surfaces become public contracts, and a related open PR proposes overlapping Google Chat thread-session behavior under a different name/scope.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Baselines
options.body: Keep this narrow default-off shape, require current-head Google Chat proof, regenerate the two tracked baselines, and resolve branch conflicts before merge.

options.title: Narrow Or Rename The Public Surface
options.body: Ask the author to keep more routing logic local or rename the config/API shape before baselines make it a public contract.

options.title: Consolidate With The Broader Thread PR
options.body: Pause this PR and settle the public Google Chat thread-session model in one canonical branch with the related open implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Baselines
recommendation.body: Keep this narrow default-off shape, require current-head Google Chat proof, regenerate the two tracked baselines, and resolve branch conflicts before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans routing, Plugin SDK public helpers, Google Chat monitor behavior, and docs surfaces touched by the PR.
